tests.platform: WSL Ubuntu, Python 3.12.14, cadquery-ocp 7.9.3.1.1; other platform results not claimed

study.pass_definition: No false accepted features or measurement errors; declared supported controls match truth. Stress misses are retained and reported. Exceptions must preserve request state or emit rejection with unknown count.

figure.verified: Rendered frozen STEP edges and measured wall evidence; visually inspected.

scope: Development controls with shared base models, not held-out population accuracy.
Same OCCT kernel for model creation, exchange and recognition; not independent metrology.
Large-coordinate misses and per-component assembly obstruction limit are retained.
No native crash injection or hard CPU/memory deadlines claimed.
